patches.implemented_text:
Among the three quotes recorded on **November 16, 2026** below, the **$84.98 single-box offer** is the only one whose known order amount is below **$100**. It leaves **$15.02 for tax or other checkout charges**. The three-box minimum starts at a **$240 goods subtotal**, and the ten-box case requires **$716.96 before tax**. Confirm the remaining checkout charges before deciding that the single-box order fits your budget.

| Recorded quote | Boxes required | Known order amount | What it means for a $100 budget |
|---|---:|---|---|
| [Great Buys single-box offer](https://www.tcgplayer.com/product/712102/pokemon-me06-delta-reign-delta-reign-elite-trainer-box?Language=English) | 1 | $84.98, with listed shipping included, before tax | $15.02 remains for tax or other charges |
| [San Diego Dawg minimum order](https://www.tcgplayer.com/product/712102/pokemon-me06-delta-reign-delta-reign-elite-trainer-box?Language=English) | 3 | $240 goods subtotal; whole-order shipping and tax unconfirmed | Already over budget |
| [Ten-box case offer](https://www.tcgplayer.com/product/712103/pokemon-me06-delta-reign-delta-reign-elite-trainer-box-case?Language=English) | 10 | $716.96 with the listed $5 shipping, before tax | Already over budget |

The single-box headroom is **$100 − $84.98 = $15.02 before unknown charges**. The minimum-order goods subtotal is **3 × $80 = $240**. These are calculations from the dated offers, not a current lowest-price ranking.

Use this order of checks: **required edition → minimum boxes → whole-order cost → budget → cost per box or included pack**. A case can have a lower unit cost while requiring much more cash. The price-per-pack figure divides a complete ETB bundle, including its promos and accessories; it does not predict the cards you will pull or assign the whole price to loose booster packs.

patches.heading: Can a 113/076 price value a 138/103 or 141/103 card?
patches.copy_en: **Do not substitute a 113/076 price reference for a Delta Reign 138/103 or 141/103 card without matching the set, language, artwork and finish.** This English checklist contains Mega Rayquaza ex at **084/103, 138/103 and 141/103**. Our **2026-11-16** check of the [PokéCottage English checklist](https://pokecottage.com/sets/delta-reign-card-list) found a **113/076** entry in a separate top-price module; the denominator alone does not establish its language.
patches.second_copy_en: The **141-card Delta Reign numbered checklist** and **PriceCharting’s displayed total of 242 catalog items** count different objects. In the **2026-11-16** source check, the [PokéCottage English checklist](https://pokecottage.com/sets/delta-reign-card-list) covered **103 main-set cards and 38 secret cards**, while the [PriceCharting Delta Reign catalog](https://www.pricecharting.com/console/pokemon-delta-reign) also showed sealed products and reverse-holo entries. Use the matching card number and finish when comparing an individual price.
